name: zum Metin
kurzbeschreibung: Cozy restaurant in Wörgl with international cuisine, pizzas, pasta and takeaway food.
beschreibung:
Zum Metin is a cozy restaurant at Friedhofstraße 7 in Wörgl in the district of Kufstein. The establishment is just a few minutes from the town centre and is a popular meeting place for locals and guests from the region.

The menu features international dishes: small snacks and salads, a large selection of pizzas and pasta, as well as other dishes from the kitchen. All food and drinks can also be ordered to take away, which makes the place particularly appealing for a quick bite in between.

It is open Tuesday to Friday from 11:30 to 14:00 and from 17:00 to 21:00, and on Sundays and public holidays from 17:00. Monday and Saturday are rest days. Orders are taken via the hotline on +43 5332 74192.
